Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting liability for persons working with liquefied petroleum gas.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to limiting liability for persons who work withliquefied petroleum gas; and adding a new section to chapter 4.24 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 4.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person who sells at retail, supplies, handles, or transportsliquefied petroleum gas is not liable for civil damages for injury orloss of property caused by: (a) The installation, alteration, modification, or repair ofliquefied petroleum gas equipment or a liquefied petroleum gasappliance if the installation, alteration, modification, or repair wasdone without the knowledge and consent of the person selling,supplying, handling, or transporting liquefied petroleum gas; or (b) The use of liquefied petroleum gas equipment or a liquefiedpetroleum gas appliance in a manner or for a purpose other than thatfor which the equipment or appliance was intended and that could notreasonably have been expected. (2) A person who follows the applicable procedures and standards p. 1 HB 1159established by the national fire protection association in NFPA 54(national fuel gas code) and NFPA 58 (liquefied petroleum gas code) maynot be deemed negligent.
